outreach_packet.subject_line: Live ops platform—next layer of gaming infrastructure
outreach_packet.hook: After backing Kaedim for AI art and Series AI for game development, I wanted to share how we're completing the stack with live operations infrastructure.

body_paragraphs.value_prop: We're building the live operations infrastructure layer for gaming—a unified platform that automates content deployment, player segmentation, event orchestration, and real-time balancing. Just as Kaedim is transforming art production and Series AI is reinventing development, we're making live ops programmable. Studios reduce deployment time by 40% and can run personalized events for player segments without engineering tickets. It's the infrastructure layer that makes AI-generated content actually deployable at scale.
body_paragraphs.market_insight: Your investments in Kaedim and Series AI show a16z's conviction that gaming infrastructure is being rebuilt with AI. The missing piece is what happens after AI creates assets and generates games—how do studios actually operate these experiences? At Riot, you experienced firsthand how live ops is the difference between a game that launches and one that thrives for a decade. With 60%+ of gaming revenue now from live services, the operational infrastructure gap is a $22B+ opportunity. This is the 'boring but critical' layer that a16z excels at identifying.
body_paragraphs.traction_ask: We're in closed beta with 3 studios including one with a top-100 mobile title, seeing 40% faster content deployment. Given a16z's leadership in gaming infrastructure and your focus on AI x gaming, we'd welcome your perspective on our Seed round. Would you have 20 minutes to discuss how live ops is becoming the platform layer for modern games?
